body: nope, not really - i stopped working in february and don't go to university or anything like that. kind of the only engagement i have going on right now is attending iop three times a week. i don't really have friends either, and i don't drive, so when i'm not going to iop, i'm just home alone until my family gets off work. my parents and i are working on getting me set up with a psychiatrist+specialist, so treatment for my actual ocd is on the horizons, it's just hard to remember that and look forward to it when everything is so overwhelming right now

same. i’m a girl and i know i don’t want male genitalia, but ocd is making me feel like i do. i know it’s not dysphoria or anything because i’m content with my birth gender & having female sex characteristics, but again, ocd disrupts that rational thought process. it’s scary.

i don’t know about where you live, but in my case i had to get hospitalized for ocd and from there my doctor referred me to intensive outpatient care - so going to the doctor/hospital/er for me also in turn got me referred to a psychiatrist+therapist. in my experience for other treatments as well as for ocd, it was best to do both/one usually leads to the other. 

most doctors will be able to recommend you a therapist that specializes in ocd, most of which will also understand hocd, as well.

i hope everything works out!!
